sn7.13:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā vātehābādhiko hoti.
sn7.13:1.3: āyasmā ca upavāṇo bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
sn7.13:1.4: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ āmantesi
sn7.13:1.5: iṅgha me tvaṃ upavāṇa uṇhodakaṃ jānāhīti.
sn7.13:1.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā upavāṇo bhagavato paṭissutvā nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena devahitassa brāhmaṇassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tuṇhībhūto ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
sn7.13:1.7: addasā kho devahito brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ upavāṇaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ
sn7.13:5.1: atha kho devahito brāhmaṇo uṇhodakassa kājaṃ purisena gāhāpetvā phāṇitassa ca puṭaṃ ca āyasmato upavāṇassa pādāsi.
sn7.13:5.2: atha kho āyasmā upavāṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ uṇhodakena nhāpetvā uṇhodakena phāṇitaṃ āloḷetvā bhagavato pādāsi.
sn7.13:5.3: atha kho bhagavato so ābādho paṭippassambhi.
sn7.13:6.1: atha kho devahito brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
sn7.13:6.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn7.13:6.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho devahito brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi
sn7.13:7.4: kathaṃ hi yajamānassa kattha ijjhati dakkhiṇāti.
sn7.13:10.1: evaṃ vutte devahito brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn7.13:10.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama. pe.
sn7.13:10.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
